a1cd5703b5.h: تحالف سياسي جديد في إسرائيل يضم حزبي آيزنكوت و«الديمقراطيون»
p: أعلن حزب «الديمقراطيون» اليساري وحزب «يشار» الذي يتزعمه غادي آيزنكوت، يوم الخميس، عن إبرام اتفاق سياسي مشترك يهدف لتأسيس الائتلاف الحكومي القادم في إسرائيل.
وتأتي هذه الخطوة لتدعم موقف آيزنكوت وتحالفه السياسي، غير أن الأغلبية المطلوبة لتولي الحكم لم تكتمل بعد لصالح هذا التجمع الجديد.

46538bafc3.h: Egypt and Qatar Urge Gaza Ceasefire and Closer Economic Ties
p: During a meeting in Cairo on Thursday, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani emphasized the urgency for all involved sides to adhere to the Gaza Strip ceasefire accord. The Egyptian presidency reported that the leaders also highlighted the necessity of securing humanitarian relief delivery and initiating early recovery and reconstruction efforts promptly.
Furthermore, the discussions between the two leaders focused on regional de-escalation alongside the enhancement of bilateral cooperation in the economic and energy sectors.

373ca5ec53.h: Coalition Spokesman Blames Houthi Militia for Jazan Refinery Assault
p: RIYADH: Houthi forces targeted the petroleum facility in Jazan, a military official announced. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who speaks for the coalition backing the legitimate government in Yemen, confirmed the hostile action through official channels.
A strong military retaliation will face any attempts to strike non-combatants and civilian infrastructure, the spokesman warned in a statement published by the Saudi Press Agency.

9c217f470f.h: ناجون يروون أهوال انفجار شاحنة الوقود في الجيزة
p: نقل شهود عيان تفاصيل مرعبة عما عاشوه، خلال حادث انفجار شاحنة وقود وقع على الطريق الدائري بنطاق محافظة الجيزة في مصر.
وأعرب هؤلاء الشهود عن صدمتهم البالغة إزاء المشاهد المروعة التي لحقت بالمكان جراء احتراق الشاحنة المحملة بالمواد البترولية.

5407c12769.h: Saudi Deputy Foreign Minister Updates Ambassadors on Houthi Assaults
p: Dr. Saud Al-Sati, the deputy minister for political affairs at the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, hosted diplomatic envoys stationed in the Kingdom for a series of briefings. The gatherings took place at the ministry headquarters in Riyadh during Wednesday and Thursday.

During these sessions, the ambassadors received detailed updates regarding Houthi assaults directed at Saudi Arabia. The meetings also included Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the spokesman for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen.

d16b65efbb.h: Army Was Aware of Explosive Hazards at Iowa Facility Over a Year Ago
p: New evidence indicates that the military branch was cognizant of instability concerns regarding explosives at an Iowa facility significantly earlier than previously understood. Initiatives aimed at eliminating these hazardous materials commenced over twelve months ago.
However, the disposal process was left unfinished during that initial period. This delay ultimately created the conditions that led to the controversial explosion on Wednesday.

5a59a4cf47.h: Two Italian Nationals Die in Kuwait Following Iranian Drone Strike
p: Officials have confirmed that two people from Italy lost their lives during an Iranian drone assault targeting Kuwait.

This tragic incident occurs amid a succession of recent attacks directed at Gulf Arab nations containing American military installations. Meanwhile, negotiations aimed at halting the ongoing conflict remain deadlocked.

214ad1a4c0.h: Egyptian Business Tycoons Pledge EGP 30m for Ring Road Fire Victims
p: Three prominent Egyptian entrepreneurs have committed a total of EGP 30m to assist the households impacted by a recent blaze on the Ring Road in Al-Warraq, according to a cabinet announcement on Thursday.
Cabinet spokesperson Counselor Mohamed Adel reported that officials received multiple support proposals from business sector representatives following the Greater Cairo tragedy.

c9daf847ec.h: SFDA and SWA Partner to Broaden Institutional Cooperation
p: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority and the Saudi Water Authority have formally entered into a memorandum of understanding aimed at deepening coordination and partnership across multiple shared domains in Riyadh.

Dr. Hisham Aljadhey, who leads the SFDA as CEO, joined SWA President Eng. Abdullah Al-Abdulkarim to finalize the agreement. The pact focuses on collaborative efforts in research and studies, alongside the utilization of shared capabilities between the two organizations.

a5a563c2a3.h: Two Italian Technicians Killed in Kuwait Strike Amid Iranian Denials
p: A strike in Kuwait resulted in the deaths of two Italian nationals. According to information provided by the foreign ministry of Italy, both victims worked as technicians for Rheinmetall, a German business.
Meanwhile, the Iranian government has rejected claims that it was involved in the incident.

a960804b5b.h: Saudi Leaders Express Condolences to Egypt's President Over Giza Blaze
p: King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman sent messages of condolence to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. The Saudi leaders conveyed their profound sympathies regarding the deadly fire incident in the Al-Warraq neighborhood located in the Giza governorate.

The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques and the Crown Prince communicated their sorrow through separate dispatches addressed to the Egyptian head of state, mourning those who lost their lives in the disaster.

6b3ddbaa22.h: Strobe Talbott, Former Diplomat and Time Magazine Journalist, Passes Away at 80
p: Strobe Talbott, who transitioned from working as a foreign policy columnist and reporter for Time to holding a high-ranking position in the State Department, has died at the age of eighty.
During his career, he functioned as the deputy secretary of state. Later, he also took on the role of president at the Brookings Institution.

93af6dccb9.h: اتفاق ائتلافي بين آيزنكوت وحزب الديمقراطيون وسط انقسامات سياسية
p: أعلن حزب غادي آيزنكوت المكلف بتشكيل الحكومة الإسرائيلية المقبلة، وحزب "الديمقراطيون" اليساري، عن توقيع اتفاق ائتلاف حكومي بين الجانبين، وذلك يوم الخميس.
يأتي هذا التفاهم ليكون الخطوة الثانية من نوعها بعد تفاهم مسبق مع حزب "إسرائيل بيتنا" اليميني، في ظل وجود انقسامات عميقة تواجه المعسكر المعارض لبنيامين نتانياهو تتعلق بالتحالفات المحتملة.

90d010a174.h: Iran Engineers Create Robotic Dog for Risky Search and Rescue
p: Engineers in Iran have created a four-legged robotic dog to aid search-and-rescue missions within dangerous settings, according to a report by Mehr News Agency, which is a TV BRICS partner. This robotic platform is capable of evaluating its environment, locating individuals trapped beneath debris, and transporting emergency supplies.
The machine features human-presence radar, gas sensors, and thermal and night-vision cameras, alongside various other systems.

91fe6a6e7d.h: Kingdom condemns deadly Iranian attack on vital Kuwaiti site
p: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement expressing the Kingdom's strongest condemnation of the heinous Iranian aggression directed at a vital location within Kuwait. The assault resulted in multiple casualties, leaving several people dead and injured.

The ministry warned that ongoing Iranian strikes contribute to heightened instability and further escalation of tensions in the region. Furthermore, the Saudi government reiterated its stance regarding these ongoing violations.

c33f90708a.h: Israeli Judges Advise Reconsidering Major Bribery Charges Against Netanyahu
p: Judges presiding over the protracted legal proceedings involving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have recommended abandoning a central corruption charge. The ongoing trial, which has caused deep polarization across the nation, centers on allegations of fraud, breach of trust, and bribery.
The prime minister has consistently maintained his innocence, rejecting every accusation leveled against him throughout the duration of the judicial process.

45c8aae3ab.h: ASEAN Specialists Tour Moscow ATOM Museum to Study Russian Nuclear Sector
p: Participants in the InteRussia international educational fellowship program "Changing Energy Landscape" recently toured the ATOM Museum located at VDNKh in Moscow. The delegation consisted of professionals hailing from various ASEAN member states, specifically Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Cambodia, and the Philippines.

During the museum visit, the visiting fellows examined an exhibition showcasing the Russian nuclear sector. The tour provided the international specialists with an opportunity to learn about the historical background of the industry.

fa1837e2c9.h: Ministry Announces Progress on Urban Spaces and Housing Targets
p: The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing reported that urban environment enhancement initiatives have successfully placed 77 percent of inhabitants within an 800-meter proximity of public areas, according to spokesperson Ahmed Al-Dhafiri. These ongoing projects encompass the creation of waterfronts.
Additionally, the ministry outlined its goals for the year 2027, which involve providing a total of 80,000 residential plots and housing units.

c104b9cb02.h: العراق يبدأ إغلاق المنافذ غير الرسمية لوقف خسائر بمليارات الدولارات
p: شرعت السلطات العراقية في تنفيذ خطوة لإغلاق المعابر الحدودية غير الرسمية، في مسعى للسيطرة على الحدود الدولية ومواجهة شبكات التهريب.

وأوضح المتحدث باسم الحكومة، حيدر العبودي، أن هذه الإجراءات تهدف إلى وضع حد لهدر الثروة السيادية للبلاد، والتي قدرت الخسائر الناتجة عنها بنحو 100 مليار دولار، مشدداً على أن الملاحقة القانونية ستطال كل من يثبت تورطه في هذا الملف.

e3af78e55c.h: Russia and Kazakhstan Reach 96% in National Currency Settlements, Putin States
p: Nearly all trade transactions between Russia and Kazakhstan are now settled using their domestic currencies, according to statements made by Russian President Vladimir Putin. During a gathering with Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, Putin noted that national currencies account for approximately 96 percent of bilateral exchanges. Details of the discussion were published by the Kremlin's official website.

Additionally, Putin highlighted that the commercial exchange volume between the two nations has surpassed twenty-eight billion US dollars and is steadily nearing the thirty billion US dollar threshold. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev acknowledged and confirmed these trade figures during their talks.

e8966e20b8.h: Coalition Neutralizes Houthi Military Assets and Missile Launcher in Yemen
p: The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen executed targeted military strikes aimed at degrading the capabilities of the Houthi militia. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the Coalition, reported that the precise operation successfully dismantled fifty legitimate military targets.

According to Al-Maliki, these operations took place across the governorates of Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada. Additionally, Coalition forces succeeded in destroying a ballistic missile launcher during the campaign.

397f627066.h: توقف مباراة بشكتاش وهابوعيل بئر السبع بسبب اشتباكات في جورجيا
p: شهدت مواجهة نادي بشكتاش التركي ونظيره هابوعيل بئر السبع الإسرائيلي ضمن منافسات الدوري الأوروبي لكرة القدم يوم الخميس توقفا اضطراريا.
جاء تعليق اللقاء لمدة نصف ساعة على خلفية وقوع مواجهات خشنة بين أفراد الشرطة الجورجية وجماهير الفريق التركي داخل المدرجات.

fdbcd85740.h: TMG and Tamer Hosny Delay Madinaty Concert Over Ring Road Tragedy
p: Talaat Moustafa Group alongside Egyptian vocalist Tamer Hosny have decided to push back their upcoming performance in Madinaty. The event, initially set for November 27, will now take place on December 4. Organizers stated the delay is a gesture of solidarity with the relatives of those who died in a severe accident on the Ring Road.
Individuals who already secured tickets for the original date can still use them for the rescheduled December concert, as current passes remain fully valid.

4ee129bb32.h: Saudi Arabia Warns UN Security Council of Terrorist Tech Exploitation
p: During a United Nations Security Council open debate addressing conflict resolution and rapid technological advancement, Saudi Arabia expressed serious concern regarding extremist organizations leveraging new innovations. Faris Al-Otaibi, the Acting Chargé d'Affaires of the Saudi Permanent Mission to the UN in New York, highlighted the specific threat of militant factions utilizing technological components to build military capabilities.
The warning delivered in New York emphasizes the Kingdom's vigilance regarding modern security challenges at the international level.

94d2e60bc9.h: Severe US Thanksgiving storms cause widespread flooding and flight delays
p: A massive Thanksgiving weather system is impacting both the eastern and western coasts of the United States, bringing heavy rainfall and severe flooding. The severe weather has also led to widespread flight delays nationwide.
Strong winds have knocked down trees and caused electricity blackouts affecting hundreds of thousands of users.

d6f3629f63.h: Driver Held Over Cairo Ring Road Tanker Fire
p: Egyptian authorities have placed the driver responsible for a fiery fuel tanker crash on the Cairo Ring Road in Warraq into custody. The incident occurred on Wednesday when the vehicle flipped over and burst into flames.

During interrogation by the Public Prosecution, the suspect acknowledged operating the vehicle alongside his father. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly went to the hospital to check on individuals injured in the accident.

84abd43c27.h: Filipino Families Seek Justice Ahead of ICC Proceedings for Duterte
p: Relatives of deceased Filipinos are pursuing accountability as former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte prepares to face the International Criminal Court. The former leader is accused of crimes against humanity, which involve eighty-five homicides.
The legal proceedings are projected to extend through 2027, providing an opportunity for victims of the alleged atrocities to deliver testimony during the court sessions.

cfbf2b1dc6.h: Expectant Prisoner Flees via New Mexico Transport SUV
p: A 26-year-old incarcerated woman named Rebecca Taylor seized control of a sport utility vehicle during her transit back to a correctional facility, according to law enforcement officials.
The incident occurred at a Whataburger parking lot while officers were returning Taylor from a medical visit related to her pregnancy.

540b51f494.h: UK Set to Cover Costs for EU Programme Access
p: Freshly published legal texts have uncovered the United Kingdom's obligation to cover a financial contribution in order to participate in European Union arrangements.
The newly disclosed documentation outlines the specific administrative costs the British government will cover as a participation fee for these cross-border agreements.
